answer: Require network-origin diversity, checked by a beacon per region. Each epoch, a beacon issues a challenge, and an identity must answer from the origin matching its profile; a prism of regional beacons triangulates each answer, so replies relayed through one data center share fingerprints and are rejected. One honest agent answers from home for free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must rent 1,000 distinct residential origins at $3 each monthly, and penalties spiral: a shared origin suspends both identities for 1 epoch, then 2, then 4, so cost grows one-to-one with every fake.
